1987.notes: LB 773 (1987) replaced the percentage-of-federal-liability tax with rates on Nebraska taxable income (federal AGI less Nebraska exemptions and standard deduction). Rates for 1987 per the DOR 'History of Nebraska Income Tax and Sales Tax Rates Through 1992' footnote. Brackets: Neb. Rev. Stat. 77-2715.02 as enacted by LB 773 sec. 8 (1987) and re-enacted by LB 739 (1989) (slip laws on nebraskalegislature.gov) sets the bracket amounts equal to the federal rate schedules for tax year 1987 (single $1,800 / $16,800 / $27,000 / $54,000; joint $3,000 / $28,000 / $45,000 / $90,000, from the IRS 1987 Form 1040 instructions); the top two federal brackets carry the same Nebraska rate (factor 1.87 each), so four brackets are recorded. Deduction = Nebraska standard deduction ($2,530 single / $3,740 joint) plus personal exemptions ($1,100 per exemption, subtracted from AGI), both per the DOR history. Nebraska tax on other federal taxes (7 x primary rate) and credits (e.g. food sales tax credit) not modelled.
